prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" connected TV (CTV) advertising agency, as the right partner depends on your budget, company size, and campaign goals.
Top CTV Platforms and Agencies
Instead of a single agency, industry reviews and user data highlight top platforms and software used for managing and running CTV campaigns:
MNTN Performance TV: Frequently praised for intuitive, self-serve dashboards that let marketers manage campaigns directly.
StackAdapt: Noted for top overall user scores and ease of daily use.
The Trade Desk: A leading demand-side platform (DSP) favored by larger media teams for enterprise-scale programmatic buying. Demandbase +2
For Startups & Small Budgets: Look for agencies or self-serve platforms that offer low minimum spends and upper-funnel tracking without enterprise fees. Stackmatix
For Enterprise Brands: Large global agency networks (such as GroupM or Publicis) handle massive, multi-channel media buys and advanced data integration.
Key Metrics to Expect: Ensure your agency provides real-time reporting, clear cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) pricing, and measurement tools tailored to your conversion goals. Paramount Ads Manager +2
If you share your budget range, company size, and whether you need self-serve software or a full-service agency, I can recommend specific options for your business.
